article.title: Stock market today: Nifty falls 0.22% to 22,698.85; IT, energy drag | 28 October 2026
article.dek: Benchmarks weakened as crude rose and IT shares sold off. Auto and pharma advanced; the latest verified FII/DII cash-flow row is dated 27 October.

visualSpec.fiiDiiNote: Latest available provisional cash-market flows are dated 27 Oct 2026; the matching 28 Oct row was not available in the NSE collector at 19:28 IST. Gross purchases/sales are exact to two decimals.

reportTakeaways: Nifty 50 fell 0.22%, while Bank Nifty gained 0.54%; index performance diverged.
Auto (+1.45%) and pharma (+1.04%) advanced; IT (-1.98%) was the weakest selected sector.
Nifty 50 breadth was 26 advances and 24 declines; wider exchange breadth was not verified.
reportWatch: The Federal Reserve decision is due after India’s close on 28 October; watch its statement and rate guidance.
Watch scheduled Q2 results from Coal India, Asian Paints, InterGlobe Aviation, Trent and Laurus Labs on the next session.
NIFTY options ATM/near-ATM OI change, PCR and expiry were not independently verified for this edition.
body: Benchmarks | On Wednesday, 28 October, the Nifty 50 closed at 22,698.85, down 50.90 points or 0.22%. The Sensex closed at 73,246.03, lower by 352.64 points or 0.48%. Nifty Bank gained 292.50 points or 0.54% to 54,267.40. The Nifty 50 recovered from its session low of 22,497.70, finishing above the intraday trough.

Breadth and volatility | Nifty 50 constituents split 26 advances, 24 declines and 0 unchanged. Nifty Bank constituents were evenly split at 7 advances and 7 declines. Nifty Midcap 100 gained 0.43% and Nifty Smallcap 100 rose 0.90%. India VIX closed at 16.36, down 0.28%. Total-market advances/declines and cash turnover were not independently verified; this report shows index-constituent breadth only.

Sector heatmap | Auto +1.45%, Pharma +1.04%, Financial Services +0.47% and Bank +0.54%. On the softer side, IT fell 1.98%, Realty 0.89%, Energy 0.89%, FMCG 0.56% and Metal 0.32%. These are index moves, not explanations by themselves.

Nifty 50 movers | Gainers: Apollo Hospitals +4.43%, Larsen & Toubro +3.72%, Trent +3.31%, SBI Life Insurance +2.06% and InterGlobe Aviation +2.03%. Decliners: Infosys -3.43%, Reliance Industries -3.19%, ONGC -2.16%, Tech Mahindra -1.92% and Bharti Airtel -1.55%.

Institutional flows | The latest available provisional cash-market row is 27 October, not 28 October. FII/FPI bought ₹24,517.65 crore and sold ₹20,277.26 crore, net +₹4,240.39 crore. DIIs bought ₹15,702.74 crore and sold ₹16,952.77 crore, net -₹1,250.03 crore. Month-to-date through 27 October remained net negative for FIIs and net positive for DIIs, as shown on the flow dashboard. These are provisional cash flows. The collector’s 28 October 19:28 IST fetch had no matching-date flow row; no same-day value is inferred.

Drivers | Reuters reported Brent crude futures up 1.4% to $115.47 a barrel after the Houthi group claimed a missile strike targeting Saudi Arabia’s largest refinery; Saudi authorities had not immediately confirmed the attack. Higher oil renews concern about imported inflation and margins in India. Indian IT and energy shares weighed on benchmarks, while global technology stocks had rallied overnight. The contrast suggests local oil and sector-specific concerns mattered; no single cause is established.

Corporate developments | Larsen & Toubro gained 3.72% after reporting Q2 FY27 net profit of ₹5,202 crore, up 32.5% year on year, according to Financial Express. Jio Platforms made a strong market debut at a premium to its issue price, but that strength did not offset pressure in heavyweight IT and energy names.

Global context | US benchmarks finished higher on 27 October as technology shares advanced. Asian markets were broadly firmer on 28 October, led by a sharp rally in South Korea after SK Hynix results; Japan also gained. Investors were cautious ahead of the Federal Reserve’s policy decision later on 28 October.

Options and activity | Current NIFTY ATM/near-ATM OI changes, PCR, and the relevant contract expiry were not verified from a reliable end-of-day chain. Exchange cash turnover and total-market breadth are also unavailable in this edition; neither is estimated.

Next session | On 29 October, scheduled results to watch include Coal India, Asian Paints, InterGlobe Aviation, Trent and Laurus Labs. The first full Indian session after the Federal Reserve announcement will also be watched for reactions in the rupee, crude-linked sectors and IT. Corporate calendars can change; check the latest exchange filings.

Factual takeaway | Nifty and Sensex declined, but Bank Nifty, midcaps and smallcaps advanced. Auto and pharma were relative strengths; IT was the clearest selected-sector laggard. The latest confirmed FII/DII row remains 27 October.
article.indiaImpact: The benchmark decline was uneven: banks and broader mid/small-cap gauges outperformed the headline Nifty, while IT and energy weakness remained visible. Oil and the Fed decision are key cross-market context.

hi.title: शेयर बाजार आज: निफ्टी 0.22% गिरकर 22,698.85 पर बंद; IT पर दबाव | 28 अक्टूबर 2026
hi.dek: निफ्टी और सेंसेक्स कमजोर बंद हुए, जबकि बैंक निफ्टी, मिडकैप और स्मॉलकैप बढ़े।
body: निफ्टी 50 में 26 शेयर बढ़े और 24 गिरे। ऑटो 1.45% और फार्मा 1.04% बढ़े, जबकि IT 1.98% गिरा।
टॉप गेनर्स में Apollo Hospitals (+4.43%), L&T (+3.72%) और Trent (+3.31%) रहे। प्रमुख गिरावट Infosys (-3.43%) और Reliance Industries (-3.19%) में रही।
सबसे हाल का सत्यापित FII/DII कैश डेटा 27 अक्टूबर का है: FII नेट +₹4,240.39 करोड़ और DII नेट -₹1,250.03 करोड़। 28 अक्टूबर का मिलान वाला आंकड़ा इस संस्करण में सत्यापित नहीं है।
तेल की कीमतों में उछाल और IT शेयरों की कमजोरी बाजार पर दबाव के मुख्य संदर्भ रहे। अगले सत्र में Fed का फैसला, कच्चा तेल और कंपनियों के नतीजे देखें।
hi.indiaImpact: सेक्टर और बाजार की चौड़ाई दिखाती है कि सूचकांकों की चाल एक जैसी नहीं थी।
